summary: Lloyds Banking Group filed a Form 6-K reporting a transaction in its own shares. The company purchased 2,162,722 ordinary shares on July 30, 2026, through broker Goldman Sachs International. Prices ranged from 110.5 to 115.85 pence, with a volume-weighted average of 112.439 pence. The purchases were part of an existing share buyback programme announced on January 30, 2026, and the shares are intended for cancellation. This routine buyback disclosure under a pre-existing programme does not alter structural terms; watch for ongoing repurchase pace and capital return consistency.
